data.name: Ruhail
data.long_meaning: Ruhail is an Arabic name that means traveler, explorer. It is derived from the word 'ruh' which means spirit, and 'hal' which means travel, journey. This name is associated with adventure and exploration, but also with spirituality and inner journeys.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruhail reflects the nomadic heritage of many early Islamic communities who were travelers and explorers by nature, constantly seeking new lands, resources, and knowledge. It also embodies the spirit of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who, in his night journey (Isra' and Mi'raj), traveled to the farthest corners of the world. As a result, the name Ruhail remains relevant for Muslims today, inspiring us to explore new horizons, to seek knowledge, and to broaden our perspectives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ruhail also holds deep spiritual significance as it relates to the idea of the spiritual journey or "safar" in Islamic tradition. It reminds us that our true purpose in life is to journey inward, to seek knowledge of God and to strive towards spiritual perfection. The name Ruhail is a reminder that our ultimate goal is not to accumulate material possessions or to seek temporary pleasures, but to embark on a lifelong spiritual journey towards God. Thus, the name Ruhail is not only associated with physical journeys and exploration, but also with the internal journey towards self-improvement and closeness to Allah SWT.
